verdict.failure_analysis: All three trials passed all 7 hidden cases, and none produced `_doing_it_wrong` records. The docs worked well on the main decisions: the `Which processor should I use?` guidance steered subjects away from the Tag Processor for full-document/title text work; `WP_HTML_Processor::create_full_parser()` clearly covered complete documents; `next_tag()` documented tag-name scanning; and `get_modifiable_text()` explicitly documented that TITLE text is carried on the opener token and returned decoded, which prevented regex use, manual entity decoding, and empty-string/null confusion.
